pass_lines_fixed_before_running.flight: a flight of at least 0.2 s while the hips travel at least 2 m
pass_lines_fixed_before_running.wall_grab: a foot planted 0.4-1.6 m up while running (travel at least 2 m), then a hand grip above the head with feet off the floor for at least 0.3 s
pass_lines_fixed_before_running.grip: a hand grip above the head with feet off the floor for at least 0.5 s
